FIELDS.NAME: The Kitchen Nook
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At The Kitchen Nook, we specialize in the retail sale of high-quality kitchen gadgets, cookware, utensils, and home decor items. Our operations are conducted strictly within our showroom, eliminating any on-site installation or repair services to minimize potential risks. We take pride in sourcing our products exclusively from certified and reputable manufacturers, ensuring quality and safety for our customers. Our team is trained in product safety and customer service best practices, creating an inviting atmosphere for customers to explore our wide array of kitchen and home accessories. Through effective inventory management systems, we conduct regular inventory audits to maintain a high standard of operational efficiency. All sales transactions are completed in-store, emphasizing a seamless shopping experience, while we consciously limit off-premises repair or installation services to maintain compliance with industry best practices and risk management protocols.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 08/15/2022; Cause: Theft of inventory due to a break-in; Amount: $5,000; Status: Paid and resolved.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM; Sunday: 11:00 AM - 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: SteelSafe Vault, Class B, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system and surveillance cameras for enhanced security.

FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – The Kitchen Nook does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – The Kitchen Nook does not sponsor any athletic teams as our focus is solely on the retail sale of kitchen and home accessories.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance, as this helps manage risk exposure. The designated personnel responsible for checking certificates will verify compliance before any subcontractor begins work.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – The applicant has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – There have been no policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years at The Kitchen Nook. All coverage has remained active and manageable since the business started.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – The Kitchen Nook does not lease employees to or from other employers. All staff are directly employed by the business.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – The Kitchen Nook does not carry Workers' Compensation insurance as there are no employees leased to or from other employers, and all staff are directly employed by the business.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – The Kitchen Nook also operates Home & Garden Decor, LLC, which focuses on retailing home decor products.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – The Kitchen Nook does not have any other insurance policies with this company apart from the primary policy number KHA-2023-001.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – The Kitchen Nook does not engage in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; we focus solely on the retail sale of kitchen and home accessories sourced from certified manufacturers.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – The Kitchen Nook does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations focus exclusively on the retail sale of kitchen gadgets and home accessories within our showroom. This approach helps us minimize potential risks associated with equipment rentals.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – The applicant has not had a foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. All financial records have been maintained in good standing.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – The Kitchen Nook does not engage in any operations involving flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our focus is solely on the retail sale of kitchen and home accessories. We ensure a safe environment by not handling any hazardous materials in our operations.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – The Kitchen Nook operates exclusively as a retail showroom with no exposure to catastrophic risks, as we do not engage in on-site installation or repairs and focus solely on selling kitchen and home accessories.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – The Kitchen Nook has had no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We maintain strict compliance with hiring practices to ensure a safe and respectful environment.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – The Kitchen Nook does not have any uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring compliance with all necessary safety regulations. Our store maintains an active fire protection system and regularly conducts safety inspections.
